title: From teacher workloads to student work, Boise schools navigate AI
description: Boise School District plans to roll out ChatGPT for teachers in spring 2027 while addressing student privacy, reviewing AI-generated materials and helping teachers navigate concerns about cheating.

title: Amazon Launches Text-to-Shop AI Agent Feature
description: Amazon.com is tapping into the increasingly popular trend for interacting with artificial intelligence agents: texting. The company announced it is launching a feature that lets customers chat with its Alexa AI agent via text messages to help them shop, much like you can with AI agents like Muse or Instinct. title: AI trade is far from over; Big Tech can still earn 'okay money', says Samir Arora
description: Helios Capital founder says investors are confusing a correction in AI stock prices with a failure of the AI investment cycle; sees a reasonable return on Big Tech’s massive capital expenditure, but remains wary of pure-play AI start-ups

title: Democrat sweep won't throw a wrench in "spokes" of AI trade: Aptus Capital
description: David Wagner, head of equity at Aptus Capital, told CNBC that the recent Democrat sweep would not “throw a wrench in the spokes of tires” of the AI trade, saying that it was easier to oppose “everything,” including data centers, while they were out of power.

title: China, Russia and US try to nail down AI nuclear agenda in time for Apec talks
description: Talks between China, the US and Russia could yield a commitment to control AI in nuclear arsenals as part of a broader agenda on global governance, sources told the South China Morning Post. The three nations have engaged in weeks of back-and-forth discussion to nail down the agenda and protocol for talks between the countries’ leaders on the sidelines of the Apec summit in Shenzhen next week.
